# Live clipper (snapshot of ../live-clipper/live_clip.py in the GTA 6 clipping workspace)
# Records a Twitch / YouTube live stream, counts chat messages in 10 s buckets, cuts a 30 s 9:16 clip around each spike with Whisper captions and an optional credit badge.
# Usage: python live_clip.py <twitch_channel | youtube live url> --minutes 120 --credit @handle
